[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bf81caf6c410c8b806c4d3c310c3dbfe956e8c18.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Take on New Frontlines: Modern Warfare 4 Season 1 Arrives on November 6![/h2][p][/p][h3]Season 1: Full Intel[/h3][p][/p][p]The hunt is on in Season 1 of [i]Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4[/i], arriving hot on the heels of the game’s launch. Highlights include new maps and modes in Multiplayer, while in DMZ, the X01 Black Site opens up along with new enemies, orders, and more. Two new Call of Duty®: Warzone™ maps — Hajin and Zodiac — plus integration with Modern Warfare 4 round out the colossal season of content.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/33f335402ca3675f976faf97d9b4f8665eeeb1ab.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]The Season 1 Roadmap. Includes major updates to Multiplayer, DMZ, and more.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Multiple in-game Events raise the stakes throughout the Season, including the Wager Match Event, Weapon Camo Events, a Squad Up Event, and more. Plus, expand your arsenal with new weapons including the CSG-35 SMG and the Cronen Osprey Assault Rifle. Later in the season, hunt down foes with the JAK 12 Shotgun and the ZLR Talonhawk Melee Weapon. [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="nemUC34Q2hQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Get ready for a massive influx of content when [i][b]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/b][/i][b] Season 1 goes live at 0000 (midnight) ET on November 6 (2100 PT on November 5)[/b] on Steam.[/p][p][/p][h3]Full Intel on Call of Duty: Warzone Coming Nov 2![/h3][p][/p][p]Play across two new maps in [i]Call of Duty®: Warzone™[/i] as the Season 1 update brings both Hajin and Zodiac, plus the return of Verdansk and Rebirth Island, additional game modes, gameplay features, and more as Modern Warfare 4 becomes fully integrated with the free-to-play game. Keep your eyes on the Call of Duty blog this Monday, November 2, for a separate post and Roadmap fully covering everything coming to [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] in Season 1. This blog focuses on the Season 1 Multiplayer, DMZ, and global game updates.[/p][p][/p][h2]Modern Warfare 4: Season 1 Multiplayer Content[/h2][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][th][p][b]MULTIPLAYER CONTENT SUMMARY[/b][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p][b]More than Six Maps:[/b] Brave inclement weather across the war torn Backstab, battle amidst towering rock walls in Canyon, and drop into a reimagined Shoot House. In the Mid-Season, drop into additional new locations: Ministry, Overflow, and additional \[CLASSIFIED] maps. Plus, play Shipment now, newly added in the leadup to Season 1.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Kill Block: Crash:[/b] Drop into Kill Block where the map is static, Crash is always front and center, and additional game modes across Core MP are available.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]6+ Modes:[/b] Kick off Halloween the right way with the pre-season arrival of Infected and Possession. At Season 1 launch, play the fan-favorite Grind mode, plus Drop Zone and Gauntlet 1v1 as part of the Wager Match Event. Expect more Modes arriving, starting at Mid-Season.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f5ad0b9233394ed19c8b3032a72c99426788143a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Multiplayer Maps[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Backstab (Launch)[/b][/p][p][i]Brand-New, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/742ed3cc25588bf3417922c52fcedc09fd634fa6.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Trek through the fallen snow of this war-torn town, where abandoned tanks litter the landscape and drone ordinance line the shelves of a deserted dwelling. Fight in the streets where long-range sightlines reign or head inside the open buildings for a closer battle.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e3a1d33124d6567fc5861ccf87fc261ae42abc22.jpg"][/img][/p][p]On the ground, use the buildings and outer walls to control your sightlines. For a greater view, look to the map’s several vantage points, including the roof of the Stronghold House and the upper levels of the Sniper House, Grandpa’s House, and the Destroyed Building. Throughout the area, blasted walls create interesting flank routes. Use everything on hand to secure the win and then get out of this frostbitten battleground.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Canyon (Launch)[/b][/p][p][i]Brand-New, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/48d03e80c56246f1167176dceefbae9c48149a05.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Turn up the heat in the sun-scorched terrain of Canyon as towering rock walls trap in the chaos below. Try your luck along the River near the site of the Convoy Ambush or take the Cliff Path for its rugged vistas and winding pathways. Featuring wide open spaces interspersed with massive natural boundaries, you’ll have to time your movements to avoid getting caught without cover.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9343bcafa35b4555ba1ef22567ff52b9a78954cd.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Head into the northern Cave to cool off in the shade, leading to an Abandoned Shack where hidden Operators can ambush passing enemies. Look for opportunities throughout to climb up to a higher vantage point, including small shelves and platforms as well as the central Mesa giving views toward both ends of the map.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Shoot House (Launch)[/b][/p][p][i]Reimagined, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5810d4c5afb6f23988cb36edf371786c7201de03.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Redeploy to Shoot House using the new combat and movement systems of [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i]. While veterans of the map will instantly recognize the layout, the setting is reimagined against the rugged terrain of North Korea during a light snowfall.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/00e9eb9b37d4c2b7ea70b9b84ed9c3632d481640.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Shoot House consists of three primary lanes: Fight across the southern Junkyard, through the tunnels leading toward the Center, or over and around the northern Containers. Operators seeking a dominant view will need to fight for control of the overhead Hospital and Apartment. Whichever path you take, there are plenty of interconnected routes between them, giving the savvy Operator a wide array of tactics throughout.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Season 1: Reloaded: Mid-Season Maps[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d454ff3fa6fc3427e9a271b8aaf2250b8c94aef2.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Ministry:[/b] Battle erupts at the Global Peace Summit, causing damage to an embassy as Operator fight in and around the building. On this diplomatic summit, only the most aggressive policies can win.[/p][p][b]Overflow:[/b] A convoy of mobile rocket launchers fire their projectiles in the distance on this map centered around a factory and its surrounding farmland.[/p][p][b]Additional Maps:[/b] Expect fierce firefights across additional, remarkable locations at mid-season, and intel dropping during the Season 1 Reloaded comms.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Kill Block: Crash[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/cd3574a87ca843529e35a68f07afa0df302748ba.jpg"][/img][/p][p]It’s helicopter down as a new featured Kill Block combo arrives for Season 1. When deploying to this map, all three slabs remain static, and do not change between rounds. This set of three slabs were hand-picked by Infinity Ward based on the most popular combinations from the MW4 Beta. This also means this Crash combination is added to a variety of other playlists throughout the Core Multiplayer Modes, including Search and Destroy.[/p][p][/p][h3]In Case You Missed It: Shipment[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Shipment (Pre-Launch, October 27)[/b][/p][p][i]Remaster, 6v6, Small-Sized[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/007321b1f9ada0e5b26475883c890b859306f811.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Shipment is back! In this remastered version, the iconic map is set on a Russian harbor, hemmed in between the water and the concrete panel buildings making up the urban landscape around it. The map itself is true to form with a classic layout and appearance that players will be right at home with, enhanced by [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i]’s visual and gameplay improvements.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5eac253e1c5e780b040ed929fcfef6bb8bee45af.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Released as part of the Preseason offering shortly after launch, Shipment is now available to play. Brave the chaos and use its relentless pace of engagements to level up those crucial early Weapon ranks, so you’re ready to go when the Season 1 Multiplayer maps arrive.[/p][p][/p][h3]Multiplayer Modes[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Possession (Pre-Season: October 29)[/b][/p][p][i]New Mode[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7b748870b24afb66c27e4ed668354c3744566b0a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]For the Halloween season, Possession is a fast, visceral party mode moshpit. Eliminate enemy players to possess them, transmigrating to their location and stealing their Loadout. Eliminate enemies to fly across the map to get on the Hardpoint, or to clear a Search and Destroy bombsite. But beware, you’ll always possess an eliminated enemy, so check your targets before committing to the kill.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Infected (Pre-Season: October 30)[/b][/p][p][i]Returning Mode[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ae73b11a2a270fc7f4a110a9c3d74c66785553e3.png"][/img][/p][p]It’s Survivors vs. the Infected in this team-based party mode where one player is randomly assigned to the Infected team at the start of the match. Every time the Infected player eliminates a Survivor, that player joins the swarm of the Infected. If you’re Infected, eliminate as many as you can to bolster your ranks. If you’re a Survivor, hold out as long as you can against the hordes of Infected.[/p][p]The Infected are all about speed and stealth, equipped with the FSS Carbon Edge Combat Knife, a Throwing Knife, and the Ninja Perk to assist in their shambling sneak attacks. Survivors carry heavier armaments like the Rezi 12 Shotgun with hot-loaded explosive slugs via the Enforcer Apex Attachment plus Trip Wire and a Concussion Grenade. [/p][p]Infect everyone or survive the game to win.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Grind (Launch)[/b][/p][p][i]Returning Mode[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/34ef7f701f92b2f83d218cee40e12eac20ffb714.png"][/img][/p][p]Eliminate players, recover their dog tags, and take them to the Bank to score in Grind. There are two Bank on the map, and both teams can deposit their carried dog tags in either one. Operators can carry multiple dog tags and will drop all carried tags upon being eliminated. Swoop them up and drop them at the Bank to score big.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Drop Zone (Launch)[/b][/p][p][i]Returning Mode[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bc55c977736f35599ef9ab8a26c64e4f5f56e332.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d23f3c4844039390c6c4acc8efcbe0e8208a34e2.png"][/img][/p][p]The rich get richer in Drop Zone, where teams fight to hold a single rotating objective. Periodic airdrops deliver Killstreak packages over the Drop Zone. Open them up for random Killstreaks you can use to defend your position or to break the enemy line the next time they have control of the Drop Zone.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Gauntlet 1v1 Gunfight (Launch, LTM)[/b][/p][p][i]Variant Mode[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/acdf199ea906f436e0cc64fb8486101a0449b20f.png"][/img][/p][p]Feeling confident? Throw down in the ultimate confrontation as Gauntlet 1v1 Gunfight arrives, accessible via the Wager Match Event. Wager your trophies and eliminate the enemy to secure the win. The winning player stays to face another opponent. Win multiple matches to claim the waged reward. More Modes Coming at Mid-Season.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9063e0ab1fce4e8cf8afd8870bd3d8047e3b49ff.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Expect multiple additional modes at mid-season, including Counter Attack, where your focus is detonating bombs at the enemy Comm Station while protecting your own from attack. Additionally, take your foes down to the ground in a new mode that adds a twist to the Team Deathmatch formula.[/p][p]And More coming via Events in the Season 1 Reloaded content drop.[/p][p][/p][h2]Modern Warfare 4: Season 1 DMZ[/h2][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][th][p][b]DMZ CONTENT SUMMARY[/b][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Infiltrate X01:[/b] [i]We've confirmed North Korean forces have set up shop in a former Russian facility on the edge of Hajin's borders.[/i] [i]Designation: X01.[/i] Search the vast cargo bays and vehicle depots, descend to underground labs, production lines, and infiltrate the sealed Deep Vault. X01’s maze of tunnels and shifting hazards calls for careful planning, specialized equipment, and squad coordination.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Orders and Threats:[/b] Ghost guides Operators through new DMZ Orders as they push deeper into X01. All further intel on the threats within this facility has been expunged from intercepted data.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Gear, Extraction, and Events:[/b] Expect new and powerful equipment, all deemed \[CLASSIFIED]. As the facility starts to close off extraction points, complete the required steps to escape, or die trying! Also available to all DMZ Operators are Events throughout Season 1, including special Commander Hunts, and other activities with rewards well worth deploying for.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h3]New Location: Designation X01[/h3][p][/p][p]New DMZ Orders incoming. Announcement for all Tier One Operators within the Hajin Exclusion Zone: [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fe4a19e30444d6096c012334d1da1fdfb97a0698.jpg"][/img][/p][p]A previously undiscovered weapons facility — codenamed X01 — has recently been seized by enemy forces. Recent reconnaissance along the northern border of North Korea has determined an infiltration point, allowing for deployment through Hajin. Current data suggests this facility was a GRANIT Arms black site. It appears comprised of a dimly lit, labyrinthian network of passageways, tunnels, and linking chambers surrounding a clandestine weapons assembly line and other, more surprising locations. Appearing to be fully enclosed from the outside world, ground-penetrating radar has revealed multi-floored vertical traversals, where the only reliable edge you may have is the back-up of your squadmates.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/99f2eeb6b29d01c5b5bf0c13a4a01d9c21c8cdf4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Expect heavy resistance, as intel brought back by Ghost indicates troops and specialists from the 100 Spirits NK Faction may be active in the vicinity, and it may be unwise to engage them in head-to-head combat. Stronger, more brutal entitles also patrol the interior, forcing Operators to study the available combat options before engaging.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/cfe1a04feedea07eb3a3970659fb8b6b5de5fab2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Gear up appropriately before infil. The rogue Operator squads moving through this facility are the least of your worries. Push deeper, uncover what’s been buried here, and make your exfil. If you can.[/p][p][/p][h3]New DMZ Orders[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9036a62785b411f1207f683a0aa814a2d66d1720.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The Watcher for operations inside X01 is Ghost, who serves as your squad’s voice on the ground, guiding Operators through X01 as you push deeper into the facility. His updates track the route, flag emerging threats, and hint at what remains as each new area is accessed. Expect multiple pages of new DMZ Orders now that infiltrations into X01 have been sanctioned.[/p][p][/p][h3]Additional DMZ Intel[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d3b8d49764867ff32ea6913b26b461296a5086ec.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The X01 facility holds more than we can disclose in this briefing; expect plenty to uncover on deployment, with key details deliberately withheld.[/p][list][*][p][b]New Enemies:[/b] \[CLASSIFIED].[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]New Items:[/b] \[CLASSIFIED].[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]New Equipment:[/b] X01 holds equipment unavailable elsewhere, with the potential to secure rare finds on every deployment. The facility’s deeper sections may yield unfamiliar tools, valuable intel, and gear built for the threats within. What you bring out is yours to discover.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Escaping X01:[/b] The Facility will take extreme measures to remove intruders its forces have not been able to extricate. Make sure you always know here the nearest exfil is.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Additional FOB Enhancements and Stations[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/47c98c969fd285f18c5ad43cc2b848000903b316.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Your Forward Operating Base continues to receive improvements, both cosmetically and functionally. Here’s some of what to look for:[/p][list][*][p][b]Battle Pass and Store Station:[/b] Access the Season 1 Battle Pass and BlackCell content, as well as Store Bundles, via a Station adjacent to the Survival Kit Station.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]3D Printer:[/b] \[CLASSIFIED]. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Vendor:[/b] Access additional weapons and gear that you can purchase with DMZ Cash, if you’ve acquired Season 1 BlackCell.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Boss Board:[/b] Lieutenants: Seek additional intel on Tae-Hyun (“Knuckle”) and Chol-Min (“The Wrench”), both dangerous adversaries to encounter within your forthcoming deployments.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Boss Board:[/b] Commanders: Seek out toughened Commanders, including The Captain (a Juggernaut and his elite guard) and an autonomous patrolling Wheelson.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Season 1 DMZ Events[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e0be2dbdc6d84655bf846c9ef97328f9d2584225.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Collaborate with squad mates and take on the biggest foes across Hajin and X01 or scavenge and sell the biggest haul of valuables to acquire high-tier loot across multiple Events. Here’s what to expect in the first part of Season 1:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Threat Briefing[/b][/p][p]Intel is everything. Learn how to identify and take down DMZ’s biggest Boss threats, then exfil with unique loot to progress and earn valuable rewards like rare gear and Survival Kits. All Squad members receive credit if one of them exfils with a scavenged part from a Commander.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0996164a8c39ce672a6a8b4b22f9024ac43137f0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Threat Briefing:[/b] [b]Battle Tank:[/b] Enter Hajin, engage a NK main battle tank in combat, removing tank parts, one per deployment. The greater the number of parts you gather over deployments, the more impressive the reward.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Threat Briefing:[/b] [b]The Captain:[/b] Enter X01, locate and engage The Captain in combat, gathering sections of the juggernaut’s helmet, in exchange for greater rewards once you successfully exfil.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Resupply Run[/b][/p][p]Race to resupply. Track down specific items across different POIs and trade them in for high-value items like Self Revives and 3-Plate Carriers to secure your haul before anyone else. [/p][p][b]Additional Events:[/b] Look for additional events across all game modes, and specifically some additional DMZ Threat Briefings, as Season 1 progresses.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ae66341a1b52bd73c04551247443f095a2b4aa05.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Modern Warfare 4: General Content (MP, DMZ, WZ)[/h2][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][th][p][b]GENERAL CONTENT SUMMARY[/b][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Weapons Detail:[/b] Expand your arsenal of weapons with the arrival of the  Cronen Osprey Assault Rifle and the CSG-35 SMG in the Season 1 Battle Pass. Later in the season, gain access to the full-auto JAK 12 Shotgun and the devastating melee axe known as the ZLR Talonhawk. Customize your weapons with new Attachments, including two new Apex Attachments.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Weapons Detail:[/b] Expand your arsenal of weapons with the arrival of the  Cronen Osprey Assault Rifle and the CSG-35 SMG in the Season 1 Battle Pass. Later in the season, gain access to the full-auto JAK 12 Shotgun and the devastating melee axe known as the ZLR Talonhawk. Customize your weapons with new Attachments, including two new Apex Attachments.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Battle Pass and BlackCell:[/b] Progress along a 100-tier linear track in the Season 1 Battle Pass, introducing new Weapon Blueprints, Operator Skins, Calling Cards, Finishing Moves, Emotes, and more across a mix of free and premium tiers. Get the premium Battle Pass to unlock a guaranteed 50+ rewards. Purchase BlackCell, or acquire the Vault Edition and receive BlackCell content, for the ultimate experience.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Season 1 Operators:[/b] Get deeper intel on the Season 1 Operators Blix and BlackCell Agent XERO, including full bios.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]C.O.D.E. Valor Pack:[/b] Call of Duty players can support veterans with the Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Valor Pack in Season 1 of [i]Call of Duty®: Warzone™[/i]. Get the pack now![/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h3]Weapons Detail[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Primary Weapon: Cronen Osprey (Launch)[/b][/p][p][i]Assault Rifle, Battle Pass Tier 16, Tier 87 Battle Pass Blueprint[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4f69263a4d9195106e156c1fc555bd8cfa94acad.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Levels:[/b] 70[/p][p][b]Rounds:[/b] 30[/p][p][b]Reserve:[/b] 90[/p][p][b]Fire Rate:[/b] 882 RPM[/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked via Battle Pass.[/p][p][b]Attachment Types:[/b] Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Ammunition, Magazine[/p][p][i]Precision-engineered for relentless performance, this 5.56 rifle delivers a best-in-class fire rate without sacrificing control, accuracy, or mobility.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ce0fc5b2f1ecbc5ccb7ee5157d89597f716f0113.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Rivaled only by the M4 in terms of its rate of fire, the Cronen Osprey combines speed with moderate power for an Assault Rifle that’s quick and reliable on the frontlines. In sustained fire, the weapon kicks up and to the right, though this can be countered somewhat with steady aiming and burst fire.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Apex Attachment: Cronen Helix Mk. II[/b][/p][p][i]A unique double-barrel receiver transforms this 5.56 rifle into a dual-fire weapon platform. Firing on both trigger pull and release, it delivers punishing damage with an unmatched rate of fire among semi-automatic weapons.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Primary Weapon: CSG-35 (Launch)[/b][/p][p][i]SMG, Battle Pass Tier 36, Tier 73 Battle Pass Blueprint[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a7d0c87813ae3bb75a0a0ef7898eb996886fa5c8.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Levels:[/b] 42[/p][p][b]Rounds:[/b] 28[/p][p][b]Reserve:[/b] 112[/p][p][b]Fire Rate:[/b] 1200 RPM[/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked via Battle Pass.[/p][p][b]Attachment Types:[/b] Optic, Muzzle, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Ammunition, Magazine[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1af8adc3ff1745c69bb13c696a7b713d3d109333.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Featuring the highest fire rate in its class pumping out rounds at a blazing 1200 RPM, the CSG-35 excels at putting down targets fast at close ranges. Though its damage per round is only modest, the rapid accumulation of follow up shots will quickly overwhelm enemies within 20 meters. Past that distance, the weapon’s climbing recoil becomes a bit harder to control, making it difficult to stay on target. For the best results, close the distance and unleash.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Apex Attachment: CSG Crossfire[/b][/p][p][i]Dual-wield akimbo CSG-35 SMGs and trade accuracy for a wave of downrange chaos.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Primary Weapon: JAK 12 (In-Season)[/b][/p][p][i]Shotgun, Event Reward[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0ca2024be1c2664d74e2d3c7355c6a9f6f46941c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Levels:[/b] \[CLASSIFIED][/p][p][b]Rounds:[/b] 8[/p][p][b]Reserve:[/b] 16[/p][p][b]Fire Rate:[/b] 323 RPM[/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked via Event.[/p][p][b]Attachment Types:[/b] Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Magazine[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ee6adebf2fe6d5fc568039cf116d149be140b1d8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Devastate close-ranged targets with this full-auto Shotgun that showers foes with a cluster of pellets. Its accuracy falls off quickly, and it kicks hard after each shot, so closing the distance is required. The JAK 12 excels as a breaching tool; if you anticipate enemies on the other side of that closed door, barge through and tear them to shreds.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Apex Attachment: JAK Barrage[/b][/p][p][i]Launch a salvo of adhesive explosives that stick to surfaces and targets before detonating with devastating results.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Melee Weapon: ZLR Talonhawk (In-Season)[/b][/p][p][i]Melee, Event Reward[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e4f6f43722f442876e9b8dce57bee3313b746991.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Levels:[/b] 10[/p][p][b]Mastery Badges:[/b] Yes[/p][p][b]Available Criteria:[/b] Unlocked via Event.[/p][p][b]Attachment Types:[/b] None[/p][p]Attack foes with a variety of hacks and slashes using this deadly Combat Axe, its heft capable of inflicting heavy damage to the unlucky recipients of its blade. [/p][p][/p][h3]New: Weapon Attachments [/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/137a7faf64751f92158dc1fe630908692c1f084b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Hyeon Auto Apex Attachment (In-Season)[/b][/p][p][i]Hyeon Burst Assault Rifle, Wager Match Event Reward[/i][/p][p]Converted to fully automatic fire, the Hyeon Auto was built for laying down stable, rapid fire. Offering a substantial increase in continuous RPM over the burst fire/semi-automatic variant, this weapon relies on firepower over precision.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Kastov 545 Apex Attachment (In-Season)[/b][/p][p][i]Kastov 762 Assault Rifle, Wager Match Event Reward[/i][/p][p]The Kastov 545 fires 5.45x39mm rounds, offering smooth handling and rapid follow-up shorts without sacrificing combat effectiveness.[/p][p][/p][p][b]M16 Burst Attachment (In-Season)[/b][/p][p][i]M4 Assault Rifle, Event Reward[/i][/p][p]Give the M4 the M16 treatment. Equip the M16 Burst Attachment to trade full-auto fire for controlled bursts. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Additional Attachments (In-Season)[/b][/p][p]Adjust your weapon arsenal still further with more Attachments to unlock, including the TT Iron Guard Kit for the .50 GS Pistol, and the ChainSAW Grip set for the FiNN LMG.[/p][p][/p][h3]Season 1 Events: Initial Intel (MP, DMZ, WZ)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/45ca91fa7d0fa10cefa7398b23d557f010ed0590.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Season 1 kicks off with the new Wager Match Event, plus additional Events as the season progresses. Participate and unlock an impressive array of rewards including new weapons, Weapon Attachments, Weapon Blueprints, Camos, Operator Skins, and more.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Event: Wager Match (MP, DMZ, WZ)[/b][/p][p][i]Rewards Include: New Attachments, Operator Skin, Weapon Blueprint, Weapon Camo[/i][/p][p]Fight for top billing in the Wager Match Event*, where Trophies are the currency and collecting more of them earns valuable rewards including multiple Weapon Attachments. Enter the Gauntlet 1v1 Gunfight playlist in Multiplayer, and other challenges across DMZ and Call of Duty: Warzone.[/p][p]Compete for extra rewards if you’re one of the top three winners, and Mastery Rewards to chase along the way, including an Operator Skin, Blueprint, Weapon Camo, and multiple weapon Apex Attachments. [/p][p][i]*No money or items of real-world value are available by participating.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Additional Events (In-Season, Mid-Season, MP, DMZ, WZ)[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Weapon Camo Events:[/b] Play matches to earn XP and acquire Weapon Camos.[/p][p][b]Joint Fire Event:[/b] While you can go solo in this party up Event, there’s a big boost to your progress if you Squad Up. Bring in your Friends to activate an XP Boost that increases for larger squads, and unlock rewards including Blueprints, Charms, 2XP Tokens, a DMZ Survival Kit, and more.  [/p][p][b]Additional Events:[/b] Look for more events coming at Mid-Season.[/p][p][/p][h3]Season 1 Battle Pass and BlackCell [/h3][p][b]Guaranteed Value and a New Streamlined Battle Pass System[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/240b10bd61170c881c911a822a6fcff1dfa6c3c6.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The Season 1 Battle Pass is packed with 100+ Rewards, including a brand-new catch-up system that guarantees 50+ rewards in the premium Battle Pass for those who purchase it. In addition to the normal unlocking of Battle Pass content, players who fall behind in the premium Battle Pass will be automatically caught up to the Reward matching the current day of the season, up to day 50. [/p][p]The Battle Pass itself is easier to navigate, too: Log in to collect your rewards and keep playing to unlock a linear 100-tier track filled with additional Operator Skins, Weapon Blueprints, Finishing Moves, Calling Cards, Weapon Charms, Reticles, and more.[/p][p]Purchase the Season 1 Battle Pass for 1,100 COD Points or the Season 1 Battle Pass Bundle for 2,400 COD Points to gain access to the new catch-up system and to immediately unlock the Battle Pass Instant Rewards, including the following items:[/p][list][*][p]10% Battle Pass XP Boost for the duration of Season 1[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Up to 1,100 COD Points[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The “Downpour” Operator Skin for Blix (shown above) and “Downpour BlackCell” Skin for those who purchase BlackCell[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The “Fortune’s Favor” FiNN LMG Weapon Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The “Happy Boom” Grenade Lethal Equipment Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The “Killing Demon” Weapon Sticker[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]DMZ Survival Kit[/p][/*][/list][p]The Season 1 Battle Pass features 100+ pieces of unlockable content (excluding BlackCell) including two new (and free) Base Weapons, and more, including new items such as DMZ Survival Kits. Expect to unlock the following as you progress through the Battle Pass:[/p][list][*][p]New Base Weapons[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Weapon Charms[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Emblems[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Calling Cards[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Double XP Tokens (Player, Weapon, and Battle Pass)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Weapon Blueprints[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Finishing Moves[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Weapon Stickers[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]COD Points[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Equipment Skins[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Loading Screens[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Weapon Decals[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]DMZ Survival Kits[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Season 1 Battle Pass Completion Rewards[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7bd5ece6469f0c794933d311ef87c4a6dbd312a7.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Players who purchase the Season 1 Battle Pass and complete all 100 tiers will earn the following completion rewards:[/p][list][*][p]The “Vantage” Operator Skin for Blix (shown above) and “Vantage BlackCell” Skin for those who purchase BlackCell[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The “Blue Viper” Hyeon Burst Assault Rifle Weapon Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]200 COD Points[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Honor’s Harbinger” Calling Card[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The “Virtue’s Snarl” Emblem[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]DMZ Survival Kit[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Ultra Weapon Blueprint Tier 100 Reward[/b][/p][p]And that’s not counting the Tier 100 reward itself, the “Bellum” Ultra rarity Mosin-Nagant Assault Rifle Weapon Blueprint.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Bonus Rewards[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Later in the season, players who have purchased the premium Season 1 Battle Pass and completed all 100 tiers get the chance to unlock a special set of additional game rewards. For Season 1, there are eight additional Operator Skins you won’t want to miss! Stay tuned for more intel when the Season 1 Reloaded Blog drops.[/p][p][/p][p][b]BlackCell Offerings[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c40f66368ba28bd7121394d356824039e07697f6.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The BlackCell faction is now active across all theaters of operations. BlackCell users will gain immediate access to the first of a trio of BlackCell Skins for Agents arriving in Season 1 under the name XERO. The clandestine XERO leads a team of additional Operators clad in Skins and carrying Weapon Blueprints earned exclusively through BlackCell.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Vault Edition Owners: BlackCell Access Granted![/b][/p][p]If you obtained the Modern Warfare 4 Vault Edition, you can unlock this season’s BlackCell offering. [/p][p]If you obtained the Digital Standard Edition of Modern Warfare 4, you can upgrade to the Vault Edition later, provided the upgrade is made on the same platform as your original purchase, unlocking [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/705521410310669069"]the many Vault Edition benefits detailed here.[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]Season 1 BlackCell[/b][/p][p]BlackCell owners can access the Season 1 Battle Pass via the exclusive BlackCell Page, instantly unlocking the following items:[/p][list][*][p]The “XERO” BlackCell Operator plus the “Cowled” and “Adder”Operator Skin variants available via BlackCell Challenges[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]1,100 COD Points[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Perimeter Lance” M4 Assault Rifle Signature Weapon Blueprint plus the “Occultus” and “Exitium” Signature Weapon Blueprint variants available via BLackCell Challenges.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Dog Food” Companion Finishing Move[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]A Custom BlackCell Lobby Scene[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Mastery Camo Track[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]20 Tier Skip Tokens[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]DMZ Survival Pack[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The “BlackCell” Clan Tag (showcased in Lobbies and during Match After Action Reports)[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]BlackCell owners get access multiple rewards within the Season 1 Battle Pass, including:[/p][list][*][p]Seven BlackCell Operator Skins for Blix (two Skins), Oh-Ji, Velikan, Min-Hee, Luca, and Dallas.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Seven BlackCell Weapon Blueprints for the Kastov 762 Assault Rifle, Axion Assault Rifle, KG-7 Vulcan Sniper Rifle, ISO Nightshade SMG, CSG-35 SMG, Cronen Osprey Assault Rifle, and the Mosin-Nagant Marksman Rifle.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Additional DMZ Benefits, to be detailed prior to Season 1 launch.[/p][/*][/list][p]Players who upgrade to BlackCell after purchasing the Battle Pass will also receive 1,100 COD Points back.[/p][p][/p][p][b]BlackCell Operator and Weapon Challenges[/b][/p][p]In addition to the Operator Skin variants for XERO, and the Signature Weapon Blueprint variants, you can unlock exclusive Universal Weapon Camos by completing BlackCell Camos. What exactly are these Camos? You’ll find out in the coming days![/p][p][/p][h3]Operators[/h3][p]Get more intel on Season 1 featured Operators XERO and Blix, who both excel in the art of stealth and precision.[/p][p][/p][p][b]XERO (BlackCell, Launch)[/b][/p][p][i]BlackCell Instant Reward[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3ce64bad7632ae525deffb3a04087c02899b0252.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]There is no record of XERO before BlackCell. Not an erased record. Not a sealed record. Nothing. The earliest known reference to him appears inside a classified BlackCell development program involving behavioral conditioning, synthetic identities, experimental combat training, and neurological augmentation. [/p][p]Whether those skills were taught, implanted, or recovered from a life XERO no longer remembers remains classified. His designation originates from X-0, an internal prototype number found repeatedly throughout damaged BlackCell archives. Later documentation replaces X-0 entirely with a single name: XERO. [/p][p]Field personnel describe him as unnervingly controlled. He demonstrates familiarity with locations he has supposedly never visited and occasionally recognizes people who insist they have never met him. Certain sounds, symbols, and encrypted transmissions have triggered brief episodes of memory that do not correspond with anything in his official history. [/p][p]BlackCell refuses to explain them. Some within the organization believe XERO was a volunteer whose identity was deliberately erased. Others believe he was assembled from the remnants of multiple failed subjects. A more disturbing theory persists among those with access to the original program: BlackCell did not erase XERO's past. They created one where none existed. [/p][p]Today, XERO operates as one of BlackCell's most closely controlled assets, deployed when an operation requires complete deniability. No country can claim him. No agency can identify him. And if BlackCell's files are accurate, XERO may not know enough about himself to ever leave them.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Blix (Battle Pass, Launch)[/b][/p][p][i]Battle Pass Instant Reward[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7ee728f8beea1ca1f0167f0c398dc3c676e8ef02.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]A former elite operator within South Korea’s Special Warfare Command, Blix’s trajectory shifted permanently after a covert border mission led to his capture and extended imprisonment. Enduring extreme hardship, he survived the ordeal only to be funneled through a network of foreign captives and deployed into high-intensity proxy conflicts.[/p][p]On the battlefield, his perspective on combat transformed into a rigid, absolute philosophy. Blix began tattooing fragments of survival codes and tactical doctrine across his skin, turning his body into a living archive of warfare. His mechanical efficiency and complete indifference to physical trauma caught the attention of the masked mercenary leader Nikto, who pulled him from the ranks to serve as a premier operative. Now deploying into the Exclusion Zone, Blix executes his objectives with silent, disciplined precision, viewing the theater of war not as a duty, but as an absolute doctrine.[/p][p][/p][h3]Support Veterans with the Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Valor Pack [/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8a476c6255e16b23350b5a989f9c82daf5282b28.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Call of Duty players can support veterans with the Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Valor Pack in Season 1 of [i]Call of Duty®: Warzone™[/i]. Get the pack now![/p][p]Created in collaboration with U.S. Marine Corps veteran and Medal of Honor recipient Kyle Carpenter, the C.O.D.E. Valor Pack is inspired by his story of courage, sacrifice, and resilience. Players will discover details influenced by Kyle's military service, including his own mottos featured on in-game weapons and other elements that honor his story.[/p][p]One hundred percent of Activision’s net proceeds for this special item, less VAT/sales tax, will be donated to the Call of Duty Endowment. For those of you who don’t know, the Endowment helps U.S. and U.K. veterans find high-quality jobs after their service. Since their founding in 2009, they have placed more than 180,000+ veterans into great jobs.[/p][p][/p][p][b]USAA Giveaway for U.S. Service Members and Veterans[/b][/p][p]And once again, USAA, a leading financial services company for the military, veterans and their families, has teamed up with the Call of Duty Endowment to offer a free Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Valor Pack for [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i], to U.S. military service members and veterans. It’s just one of the ways we can say thank you for your service to our country.[/p][p]Once you click the link for redemption below, you will be redirected to an [url="https://www.xnow.com/embedded/flow/usaa-cod-military-verification"]XNow account sign-in page[/url] to claim your prize. [url="https://www.callofdutyendowment.org/sweepstakes"]See official rules.[/url][/p][p][/p][h3]Verify Your Email, Unlock “Locked Down” Weapon Camo[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/81ee798c48038aaa45f8002150a2b9125e43b172.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Unlock the “Locked Down” Universal Weapon Camo simply by verifying your email! Verifying your Call of Duty account email helps strengthen security. Once you complete this verification, prepare to receive the following, added to your Call of Duty Account:[/p][p]For more info on email verification, [url="https://support.activision.com/articles/activision-account-email-verification"]visit our Activision Account Email Verification FAQ here.[/url][/p][p][/p][h2]Purchase Modern Warfare 4 Today! [/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0de45a72bf28b7c11ccdbf0ba91f145349fe84cd.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4435490/Call_of_Duty_Modern_Warfare_4/"]Purchase Modern Warfare 4 on Steam today[/url] and stay tuned for all your [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] intel needs for Season 1 and beyond![/p]

newsitems.contents:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d897bb630fb567f1b11e928a2b353031645abb21.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare 4[/i] is now live worldwide! In the epic Campaign, Price is on the run, conflict has erupted on the Korean Peninsula, and a catastrophic weapon of war is on the verge of falling into the wrong hands. [/p][p]Deploy across 20 Multiplayer maps at launch, including 12 new 6v6 maps, 4 Gunfight maps, 3 Ground War maps, and the new Kill Block modular training facility. Experience grounded, precise combat built around fluid movement, player choice, and greater control in every engagement. [/p][p]In the DMZ extraction mode, operate as an off-the-books asset behind enemy lines, where every deployment into contested territory forces hard choices about which objectives to pursue, what to secure, and when to get out. [/p][p]Keep reading for all the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] launch intel you need, so that you’re fully prepared to kick off an incredible Modern Warfare experience. Here’s what you should know:[/p][p][/p][h2]Modern Warfare 4 Launch Comms[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a3008575ab81f3d6ed17d6da730896927f975cee.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]What Do I Need to Know About Modern Warfare 4?[/h3][p][/p][p]Get up to speed on the major [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] beats:[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/719041721925633150"]The Story So Far[/url] and [url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/1938090/announcements/detail/683013558653419697"]Campaign Trailer[/url][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/671757096278033470"]All Multiplayer Operators, Weapons, Equipment, and Create-a-Class Features[/url][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/671757096278035866"]Multiplayer Maps and Modes[/url][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/671757096278033531"]Progression and Prestige[/url][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/714540024688805804"]DMZ Deep Dive Part 1: Tour of Duty – Hajin Environments and Threats[/url][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/714540659097208825"]DMZ Deep Dive Part 2: How to Play – Forward Operating Base (FOB)[/url][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/692021394394843423"]PC Trailer, Tech Updates, and More[/url][/p][p][/p][h2]Unlock More with the Modern Warfare 4 Vault Edition[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/381cdc27c05d5a93e83376c2a1b742a07de5ab03.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]What Extra Content Does the Vault Edition Include?[/h3][p][/p][p]Purchase the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Vault Edition for even more premium content with an exceptional value, including bonus rewards available only through this edition. Secure the Vault Edition to gain access to all included content, rewards, and edition-specific benefits:[/p][p] [/p][list][*][p][b][i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i][/b] Digital Edition[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Hunter Killer Operator Skin:[/b] Gain access to the Hunter Killer Operator Skin.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Hostile Alliance Operator Pack:[/b] Gain access to Operator Skins for Price, Valeria, Ghost, and Blix.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Special Forces Operator Pack:[/b] Unlock the Special Forces Operator Pack, including Operator Skins representing the United Kingdom, Germany, France, and South Korea, each with voice packs in their local languages.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Signature Weapon Collection:[/b] Flex your loadout with the Signature Weapon Collection, featuring five different Signature weapons equipped with multiple Attachments including an Apex Attachment, including:[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Voltspine” Kastov 762 Assault Rifle Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“La Sombra Venenosa” (“The Poisonous Shadow”) ISO Nightshade SMG Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Shattered Code” Rezi 12 Shotgun Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Volt-Edge” Oris 8.6 Marksman Rifle Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Sombra Besada” (“Shadow’s Kiss”) Combat Knife Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]BlackCell* (One Season):[/b] Jump start your journey with BlackCell benefits including access to BlackCell content, the current Battle Pass, and up to 20 Tier Skips.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]DMZ Deployment Bonus:[/b] Get a head start in DMZ with the DMZ Deployment Bonus.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Upgrade to the Vault Edition[/b][/p][p]If you pre-ordered the Digital Standard Edition of [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i], you can upgrade to the Vault Edition at a later date, provided the upgrade is made on the same platform as your original purchase, unlocking the many Vault Edition benefits detailed above.
[/p][p][b]Note:[/b] Upgrade steps may vary by platform. Refer to your platform’s storefront for details.[/p][p][/p][h2]NEW: Support Veterans with the Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Valor Pack[/h2][p][/p][previewyoutube="tTKfKjWpxmA;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Starting today, support veterans with the Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Valor Pack for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. The pack will be available at launch in Multiplayer and DMZ before it releases in Call of Duty: Warzone™ with Season 1. [url="https://www.callofduty.com/valor"]Get the pack now.[/url][/p][p]Created in collaboration with U.S. Marine Corps veteran and Medal of Honor recipient Kyle Carpenter, the C.O.D.E. Valor Pack brings the story you've seen throughout Forged in Valor into the game. Working closely with the Infinity Ward and Endowment teams, Cpl. Kyle (Ret.) helped shape a pack filled with personal references drawn from his life, service, recovery, and the mindset that continues to drive him forward.[/p][p]The Valor Pack includes the following in-game items:[/p][list][*][p]“Valor” Operator[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Relentless” Operator Skin[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Forged Resolve” M4 Assault Rifle Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Still Standing” Rezi 12 Shotgun Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Worth Fighting For” Combat Knife Melee Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Nice Try” Weapon Charm[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Steel Talon” Weapon Sticker[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Forged in Valor” Calling Card[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Earned, Not Given” Emblem[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]“Blood, Sweat, & Sand” Loading Screen[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]1 Hour Double Level XP Token  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]1 Hour Double Weapon XP Token [/p][/*][/list][p][i]"There are two types of courage: the courage to act and the courage to endure."[/i] – Kyle Carpenter[/p][p][/p][p]From phrases that have guided him through adversity to details inspired by real moments from his military journey, every item reflects the resilience, determination, and optimism that define his story.[/p][p]Among the items is Kyle's favorite, the "Nice Try" Weapon Charm, a playful nod to the humor, attitude, and resilience that have become part of his story. While the pack honors remarkable acts of courage, it also captures the mantras that continue to drive Kyle forward today.[/p][p]One hundred percent of Activision’s net proceeds will be donated to the Call of Duty Endowment. For those of you who don’t know, the Endowment helps U.S. and U.K. veterans find high-quality jobs after their service. Since their founding in 2009, they have placed more than 180,000+ veterans into great jobs. [/p][p][/p][p][b]USAA GIVEAWAY FOR U.S. SERVICE MEMBERS AND VETERANS[/b][/p][p]Once again, USAA has teamed up with the Call of Duty Endowment to offer a free Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Valor Pack for [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i], to U.S. military service members and veterans. It’s just one of the ways we can say thanks for your service in our country.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://www.xnow.com/embedded/flow/usaa-cod-military-verification"]Click here for redemption[/url] to be redirected to an XNow account sign-in page to claim your prize.[/p][p] [/p][p]Eligibility: U.S. active and former military members only. While supplies last. Quantities limited. XNow account required. See the official rules here.[/p][p][/p][h2]Link Your Discord Account[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/97f45a2683d2abd6ddd2b58d39f322f69782b499.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We are adding new Discord features to [i]Call of Duty[/i]! By linking your account, you will have direct access to your Discord friends and have the ability to send invites directly from the game. As a thank you, players who link their accounts will receive a bonus Calling Card. [/p][p] [/p][p]For players who linked their Activision and Discord accounts during the Beta: with the launch of [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i], you will need to link your account again to access these functionalities. Your bonus Calling Card will already be in your inventory, and you will also be given 1-hour Double XP and 1 hour Double Weapon XP. [/p][p] [/p][p]Follow these steps to link (or re-link) your account:[/p][list][*][p][url="https://profile.activision.com/login?locale=en&redirectUrl=https://profile.activision.com/login?locale%3Den&theme=activision.com&loginToken=fd19af0c-5919-b753-7639-93609fc4ca8d&recaptcha=true"]Sign in to the Activision account[/url] used to play [i]Call of Duty[/i].[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Open Account Linking and select Discord.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Sign into the Discord account you want to link, and if you agree to link your account, hit authorize.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Return to Call of Duty and restart the game for the connection to take effect and the new features to become available.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]If you're playing on PC, you can also follow the instructions within the game under the Discord tab in your Social menu.[/p][p][/p][h2]Purchase Modern Warfare 4 Today![/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/06286aae5407416d91970777d6eefd1a3b2590a6.jpg"][/img][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4435490/Call_of_Duty_Modern_Warfare_4/"]Purchase Modern Warfare 4 today[/url] and stay tuned to the [url="https://www.callofduty.com/blog"]Call of Duty Blog[/url] for all your [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] intel needs at launch and beyond![/p]

newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/736fbd2908280146bdce5b8f2be92d2a8a4bb032.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Multiplayer: Launch Maps[/h2][p][/p][p]Modern Warfare 4 launches with 12 Core 6v6 maps (plus Shipment arriving shortly after launch on October 27), three large-scale 32v32 Ground War maps, four 2v2 Gunfight maps, and the modular battleground, Kill Block, supporting 3v3 and 10v10 Gunfight.[/p][p]Here’s a look at all of the maps, including Tac-Map displays for each of the Core 6v6 and Ground War 32v32 maps:[/p][p][/p][h3]Core 6v6 Maps[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Cachette[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ce5ada6d0fe9254ca29a12af7b711fbec9f0f621.jpg"][/img][i]Launch Map · 6v6[/i][/p][p]On the outskirts of a French rail terminal, an abandoned wine warehouse and derelict mechanic’s garage have been converted into a covert armory.[/p][p][/p][p]Check out the interactive Tac Map [u][url="https://www.callofduty.com/guides/modernwarfare4/multiplayer-maps/launch/cachette"]here[/url][/u].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Coal[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4e9a35c482d83fbeffe74b82d054f2c2fe35f36e.jpg"][/img][i]Launch Map · 6v6[/i][/p][p]Fight through the remains of an old Soviet coal processing plant in a remote, mountainous area, complete with a fallen smokestack, ore chutes, and processing buildings feeding into a slurry-filled river and polluted flood plain. [/p][p][/p][p]Check out the interactive Tac Map [u][url="https://www.callofduty.com/guides/modernwarfare4/multiplayer-maps/launch/coal"]here[/url][/u].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Lithium[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/428b78a8396fe9ee9074edc879eeb439c61d8500.jpg"][/img][i]Launch Map · 6v6[/i][/p][p]Deep within a rural Mexican state beneath the Sierra Mountains, Corporación Mexicana de Litio’s Lithium processing refinery has come under attack, transforming the site into an active combat zone.[/p][p][/p][p]Check out the interactive Tac Map [u][url="https://www.callofduty.com/guides/modernwarfare4/multiplayer-maps/launch/lithium"]here[/url][/u].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Lotus[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d4eec0bc52414a74c4d42967501cb811f527f1fd.jpg"][/img][i]Launch Map · 6v6[/i][/p][p]A South Korean fishing village in the aftermath of an amphibious assault, its market, hostel, boathouse, gardens, and residential blocks left scarred by the fight to reclaim it.[/p][p][/p][p]Check out the interactive Tac Map [u][url="https://www.callofduty.com/guides/modernwarfare4/multiplayer-maps/launch/lotus"]here[/url][/u].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Mumbai[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7c8c4ebe69457272587045fe9ade623ac3248480.jpg"][/img][i]Launch Map · 6v6[/i][/p][p]A fugitive’s hideout hidden inside a dense residential district centered around a Victorian market, with a rail line cutting through tightly packed residential blocks. [/p][p][/p][p]Check out the interactive Tac Map [u][url="https://www.callofduty.com/guides/modernwarfare4/multiplayer-maps/launch/mumbai"]here[/url][/u].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Munition[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/05f4edd8882ee4ab23c063a9fa1e68a2892fc8fb.jpg"][/img][i]Launch Map · 6v6[/i][/p][p]An active North Korean command facility with a large munitions depot, monitoring rooms, a linked skybridge, crane, water tower, and multiple hangars.[/p][p][/p][p]Check out the interactive Tac Map [u][url="https://www.callofduty.com/guides/modernwarfare4/multiplayer-maps/launch/munition"]here[/url][/u].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Nautical[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/428c3eb3724cb0be2f15975bc7b5dbd1add2fc9c.jpg"][/img][i]Launch Map · 6v6[/i][/p][p]At dawn, a South Korean ferry pulls away from a major conflict zone as debris litters the decks and fires burn across the starboard side and bow.[/p][p][/p][p]Check out the interactive Tac Map [u][url="https://www.callofduty.com/guides/modernwarfare4/multiplayer-maps/launch/nautical"]here[/url][/u].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Reactor U92[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/963d464860567fd35cd613111fb69144a086bc9f.jpg"][/img][i]Launch Map · 6v6[/i][/p][p]A South Korean reactor complex has gone nuclear. Electrical damage arcs across the large concave command room, while the boiling containment pool appears to be the epicenter of a massive meltdown.[/p][p][/p][p]Check out the interactive Tac Map [u][url="https://www.callofduty.com/guides/modernwarfare4/multiplayer-maps/launch/reactor-u92"]here[/url][/u].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Rooftops[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d02cc7d116337cf134f3f1dd46dcc8ddfdf9dbbd.jpg"][/img][i]Launch Map · 6v6[/i][/p][p]The snow-lined rooftops of New York’s “Hotel Times West” create combat opportunities across a rooftop greenhouse, HVAC platforms, boiler room, patio, skylights, pigeon coop, and laundry room.[/p][p][/p][p]Check out the interactive Tac Map [u][url="https://www.callofduty.com/guides/modernwarfare4/multiplayer-maps/launch/rooftops"]here[/url][/u].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Sentry[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fab6c69e6998ce6ee6bd7b105609d773c1061af9.jpg"][/img][i]Launch Map · 6v6[/i][/p][p]An assault on a Russian military base under whiteout conditions sparks firefights across the maintenance garage, generator room, and substation surrounding a central command center and partly destroyed barracks.[/p][p][/p][p]Check out the interactive Tac Map [u][url="https://www.callofduty.com/guides/modernwarfare4/multiplayer-maps/launch/sentry"]here[/url][/u].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Silkworm[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e7b9a363d9173b3b25a3b5e0d8284c48372edc0d.jpg"][/img][i]Launch Map · 6v6[/i][/p][p]Infiltrate a dense, urban South Korean shopping district with alley access around perimeter apartments, as the action centers on a well-stocked convenience store, gaming den, and central subway entrance.[/p][p][/p][p]Check out the interactive Tac Map [u][url="https://www.callofduty.com/guides/modernwarfare4/multiplayer-maps/launch/silkworm"]here[/url][/u].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Transit 213[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3f427988aa6174cad1dcc6c046db9ca03cf6764a.jpg"][/img][i]Launch Map · 6v6[/i][/p][p]An overgrown central parking lot in western India packed with brightly colored buses in various states of dereliction, flanked by a repair shop and small gas station and surrounded by construction projects and high-rise tenement blocks.[/p][p][/p][p]Check out the interactive Tac Map [u][url="https://www.callofduty.com/guides/modernwarfare4/multiplayer-maps/launch/transit-213"]here[/url][/u].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Shipment[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/007321b1f9ada0e5b26475883c890b859306f811.jpg"][/img][i]Post-Launch Map · 6v6[/i][/p][p]Shipment returns! Arriving shortly after launch on October 27, the infamous small map is set on a Russian harbor, hemmed in between the water and the concrete panel buildings making up the urban landscape around it. The map itself is true to form with a classic layout and appearance that players will be right at home with, enhanced by Modern Warfare 4’s visual and gameplay improvements.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Ground War 32v32 Maps[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Imjin Farmland[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/548cc5596f9cf48ca78391e975e9a06a65070c72.jpg"][/img][i]Launch Map · 32v32[/i][/p][p]Battle across the rural outskirts of Hajin, where open fields, waterways, scattered farms, and the large-scale mill combine with roads and rail lines to create a combat zone suited to long sightlines, vehicle maneuvering, and coordinated assaults on key strongholds.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Wolves Stadium[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6e69fe588f0d2a2970e5c17b9a2cb770cbc14e76.jpg"][/img][i]Launch Map · 32v32[/i][/p][p]Fight through the heart of Hajin in a dense urban environment centered on the Wolves Stadium. Multi-story buildings, transit lines, tunnels, rooftops, and surrounding hillsides create a highly versatile arena of battle where every route offers multiple ways to advance.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Forest[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0da9a3802544a7852591e81349f81fe7d685102d.jpg"][/img][i]Launch Map · 32v32[/i][/p][p]Positioned between the Imjin Farmlands and Wolves Stadium, Forest challenges Operators to battle over and around a wooded hillside. A network of streets, off-road paths, and the southern train tracks provide room for vehicles to navigate the area, while points of interest like the guard tower at the top of the hill, the gas station, and the barracks mark key objective points that can be used to defend against unseen attackers behind the tree line.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Gunfight 2v2 Maps[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Cafe[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a6d557a51db6c0c7a3fc0823d819681f314164e3.jpg"][/img][i]Launch Map · 2v2[/i][/p][p]Deploy to a scenic courtyard in Paris featuring a theater, magazine kiosk, and a central fountain that blocks views down the middle. Climb up to the statue on top for a better view or try your luck on the outer perimeter where there’s sparse cover but longer sightlines.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Library[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/68eef23e20554e30951933bed67f6cfa2e070ce3.jpg"][/img][i]Launch Map · 2v2[/i][/p][p]Disturb the peace in this wood paneled state library that packs tactical opportunities into a tight space. Watch for enemies lurking behind bookshelves and rushing through the center. Take the stairs to get up on the center walkway with views over both sides of the map.[/p][p][/p][p][b]NYC[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1420295e9cf512fd9157c947c16ad7ef4ab176ca.jpg"][/img][i]Launch Map · 2v2[/i][/p][p]Pack warm for a wintry night in the thick of downtown. A large stage dominates the center surrounded by stands, equipment, and vendors. Weave between objects on the ground to flank enemies or climb up to one of the many scattered vantage points throughout.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Smuggler[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c3234a743497b3dd6dd562ac5988e4ead6c478ba.jpg"][/img][i]Launch Map · 2v2[/i][/p][p]Take the fight to a rail yard where several train cars are parked on the tracks. Battle in, around, and on top of them with ladders giving access to the roof. For a closer fight, head into the warehouse on either side or move out to the ends where there’s more open space to move around.[/p][p][/p][h3]Kill Block[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/70bd4ae169e55e582fe8a995ee339c10250054a1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Launch Map · 3v3 / 10v10[/i][/p][p]The Westbridge Training Facility — AKA Kill Block — is a modular Multiplayer battleground featuring reconfiguring combat layouts. Designed as a live-fire training environment, Kill Block reconfigures between rounds, forcing players to reassess sightlines, routes, and combat spaces. With more than 500 combinations, no two Kill Block deployments play out the same.[/p][p]Some map sections are entirely new, while others draw inspiration from iconic locations across Modern Warfare history including Crash, Highrise, and Shoot House, appearing in randomized placements each match. Supports 3v3 and 10v10 Gunfight at launch.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Multiplayer: Launch Modes[/h2][p][/p][p]Play over a dozen Multiplayer modes at launch, including a variety of Standard, Alternate, and Hardcore variants, plus a Mobility Course designed to help you master the Modern Warfare 4 movement system.[/p][p][b]NOTE:[/b] Hardcore rules include a limited HUD, friendly fire, and reduced health with no regeneration.[/p][p] [/p][p]The available game modes at launch include:[/p][p][/p][h3]Respawn Modes[/h3][p][/p][p][b]New Mode: Inflation[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bb6bae90932ce61f52df4eded37a7f2ba981283a.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bbcd2ed239d32708c512fc6fc390a17c2d18a4b9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Standard Mode · Core · Hardcore[/i][/p][p][i]Match time: 10 Minutes · Score Limit: N/A · Party Size: 1-6[/i][/p][p]Eliminate enemies and collect their bounty of cash, but the more wealth you carry, the greater the target on your back. Players who reach the High Value Target threshold will have their position revealed to friends and foes alike, turning Inflation into a balance of hunting down enemy HVTs while protecting your own. [/p][p]Eliminated players drop a portion of their cash, with an Overtime that activates in the final minutes setting up bigger cash multipliers for wild late game swings. The team with the most cash at the end wins.[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Mode: Hijack[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ff95f4460f563db770ef2102c5ceaa3d0e33a71e.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/968b15266e051ebd4e4d63f1ccceace45bde6a55.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Standard Mode · Core · Hardcore[/i][/p][p][i]Match time: 4 Minutes per Round · Score Limit: 300 · Party Size: 1-6[/i][/p][p]Teams fight for control of a single Data Spike that they can carry, throw, and pass to teammates on the way to the enemy Comm Station. Plant the Spike to score points over time and earn a bonus if the upload is completed, requiring a sustained defense of the area after planting to prevent the enemy from aborting the data transfer.[/p][p]Teams swap sides between rounds and the Data Spike occasionally resets to the center when dropped and not picked up in time, when the spike is thrown out of bounds, or after a successful defuse.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Frontline[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3cfe4c95fb5fc2ea04f2848f41a1736882db4f26.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Standard Mode · Core[/i][/p][p][i]Match time: 10 Minutes · Score Limit: 100 · Party Size: 1-6[/i][/p][p]Push the line in this team-based respawn mode where players always deploy from their team’s base. Eliminate enemies to score, with eliminations earned outside of the base counting for more, encouraging teams to push forward and spread out through the map. Players gain a small window of invincibility after spawning and teams change sides once one team earns half of the max score limit. The first team to reach the score limit wins.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Team Deathmatch[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1465e4fb6dadd15680833394b0a8bb2fced7471d.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f5c9adab750e9aa13c280ef6b72408882d345f69.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Standard Mode · Core · Hardcore[/i][/p][p][i]Match time: 10 Minutes · Score Limit: 100 · Party Size: 1-6[/i][/p][p]Eliminate enemy players until the score limit is reached to win.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Domination[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4ed9a90f3f33bc131bb2a5db52366360a62e9845.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Standard Mode · Core · Hardcore[/i][/p][p][i]Match time: Unlimited · Score Limit: 200 · Party Size: 1-6[/i][/p][p]Capture, hold, and defend objectives to earn points. First team to the score limit wins.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Hardpoint[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0ef953f41106d7b147b4f4e154b92cde59e332ea.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/704f0d61634e1842b96558977cb661cd5235334a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Standard Mode · Core · Hardcore[/i][/p][p][i]Match time: 5 Minutes · Score Limit: 250 · Party Size: 1-6[/i][/p][p]Capture the rotating Hardpoint and hold it against attack. The first team to reach the score limit wins.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Kill Confirmed[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/43e4770f5368d1aa78288e835494ead38f490259.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a85c70c087960fb073fd0eab219994e73925f5c1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Standard Mode · Core · Hardcore[/i][/p][p][i]Match time: 10 Minutes · Score Limit: 75 · Party Size: 1-6[/i][/p][p]Recover dog tags to score for your team and deny enemy scores.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Free-For-All[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/10c213107c27f16344891c0c6067a1a88a5fa6e1.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f0a6b7561242c75522be98dc41c4dd8a285a6c9b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Standard Mode · Core · Hardcore[/i][/p][p][i]Match time: 10 Minutes · Score Limit: 30 · Party Size: 1[/i][/p][p]Eliminate everyone. The first player to reach the score limit ends the game. The top three players win.[/p][p][/p][h3]Round-Based Tactical Modes[/h3][p][/p][p][b]New Mode: Collateral[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1755a1fa1a6f6db40d251b2eaafa4ab872d8fe1c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/200b37591fabd3b18903332bfee476414473e131.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Standard Mode · Core[/i][/p][p][i]Match time: 2 Minutes per Round · Score Limit: 6 · Party Size: 1-6[/i][/p][p]Start with a Pistol and $800 and earn extra cash to spend on better gear between rounds in this exciting new mode blending Search & Destroy mechanics with a Buy Phase system that lets players improve their loadouts as the match progresses. Teams alternate between attacking and defending two bomb sites, and the better you do, the more cash you’ll earn to spend during the pre-round Buy Phase. Get rewarded for planting and defusing bombs, eliminating players — with varying levels of payout for different kinds of kills — and winning the round.[/p][p]There are no respawns and no custom loadouts. When you die, you lose your loadout and start over, but you keep the cash you’ve earned. The Buy Menu features the following options, including the ability for teams to pitch in for a UAV going into the next round: [/p][p][/p][p][b]Armor and Perks:[/b] Armor Vest, Battle Hardened, Lethal Reach, Fast Hands, Ghost[/p][p][b]Equipment:[/b] Flash Grenade, Molotov Cocktail, Frag Grenade, Stim, Smoke Wall, Riot Shield[/p][p][b]Pistols:[/b] Krait P68 Silenced Pistol, Mojave .357Revolver, Sang 9mm Akimbo Pistols, .50 GS Power Pistol[/p][p][b]Standard Issue:[/b] Rezi 12 Shotgun, FiNN Light Machine Gun, Oris 8.6 Marksman Rifle, X-58 Nyx Silenced SMG, Wz. 55 Striga Agile SMG[/p][p][b]Tier 1:[/b] MAR-9 Marksman Rifle, Kastov 762 High Damage Rifle, Hyeon Burst Assault Rifle, M4 Silenced Rifle, KG-7 Vulcan Sniper Rifle[/p][p][b]Team Buy:[/b] UAV[/p][p][/p][p]When purchasing new weapons, drop some extra cash for an upgrade, adding the displayed attachments to the weapon to further improve its lethality.[/p][p]Every dollar counts and every decision matters. The first team to take six rounds wins the match.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Search & Destroy[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/50ad9ca056f7d6f9df53007409f27315a41a6c80.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a9adc810a4fbcab5fdf329e7f8da46d50b9d8235.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Standard Mode · Core · Hardcore[/i][/p][p][i]Match time: 2 Minutes per Round · Score Limit: 6 · Party Size: 1-6[/i][/p][p]The classic high-stakes, round-based tactical game mode where teams alternate between attacking and defending two bomb sites. There are no respawns here, turning every encounter into a high-tension fight. Win the round by planting or defusing the bomb, or alternately by eliminating the entire enemy team. [/p][p]Planting and defusing the bomb leaves the acting Operator defenseless for several seconds, so bring backup and plan your objective plays accordingly. The first team to win six rounds wins the match. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Gunfight[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/602179c60a773acd0b9a0a5c8bf64cbca22e3da5.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f4a06749359ffd7ea737a77f78ed842a017321b1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Standard Mode · Core · 2v2 / 3v3 / 10v10[/i][/p][p][i]Match time: 50 Seconds per Round · Score Limit: 6 · Party Size: 2, 3 or 10[/i][/p][p]Eliminate the enemy or secure the Overtime Flag. All Operators begin each round with the same Loadout which changes every two rounds. The first side to reach the round limit wins the match.[/p][p][/p][h3]Ground War[/h3][p][/p][p][b]New Mode: Combat Outpost[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/cc13ff3106edd3006c1ccc78e21519aff8ec671d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Alternate Mode · Core[/i][/p][p][i]Match time: 20 Minutes · Score Limit: 1500 · Party Size: 4, 32v32[/i][/p][p]Combat Outpost reimagines Domination for Ground War, expanding the familiar three-flag battle into a large-scale conflict across a sprawling battleground. Capture Outposts to earn a steady stream of points while expanding your team's available spawn locations, allowing friendly forces to reinforce the front line and maintain pressure across the map.[/p][p]The battle doesn't end once an Outpost is secured. Operators can reinforce captured positions to unlock increasingly powerful team rewards, from Local UAV coverage and a JLTV airdrop to a Light Tank delivered straight to your Headquarters. With Capture and Reinforce objectives often overlapping, Combat Outpost rewards teams who can seize territory, defend key positions, and leverage heavy ordinance.[/p][p][/p][h3]Party Mode[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Gun Game[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/63a8a2d51f55a9515b23d525b24243c8711fbcbb.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Alternate Mode · Core[/i][/p][p][i]Match time: 10 Minutes · Score Limit: 15 · Party Size: 1[/i][/p][p]Eliminate players with your weapons to advance to the next weapon. First to eliminate with each weapon wins.[/p][p][/p][h3]Proving Grounds[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c479e854f14c52491fa1664e1bcfe9bb7d90bd8b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8d7d1ef53233f772ef39259e045dda5b2c9c307f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Launch[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Master the Modern Warfare 4 movement system in the Proving Grounds, a dedicated training course that will guide you through movement Tutorials and timed Courses. Strive for an S Rating in every Course and take those skills into Multiplayer, turning you into a formidable force before you’ve even played your first match.[/p][p][/p][h3]Pre-Season 1 Modes[/h3][p][/p][p]Plus, look out for two extra Multiplayer modes arriving just in time for Halloween in the leadup to Season 1, including:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Possession (Pre-Season 1)[/b][/p][p][i]New Mode[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7b748870b24afb66c27e4ed668354c3744566b0a.png"][/img][/p][p]For the Halloween season, Possession is a fast, visceral party mode moshpit. Eliminate enemy players to possess them, transmigrating to their location and stealing their Loadout. Eliminate enemies to fly across the map to get on the Hardpoint, or to clear a Search and Destroy bombsite. But beware, you’ll always possess an eliminated enemy, so check your targets before committing to the kill.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Infected (Pre-Season 1)[/b][/p][p][i]Returning Mode[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ae73b11a2a270fc7f4a110a9c3d74c66785553e3.png"][/img][/p][p]It’s Survivors vs. the Infected in this team-based party mode where one player is randomly assigned to the Infected team at the start of the match. Every time the Infected player eliminates a Survivor, that player joins the swarm of the Infected. If you’re Infected, eliminate as many as you can to bolster your ranks. If you’re a Survivor, hold out as long as you can against the hordes of Infected.[/p][p][/p][h2]Pre-order Modern Warfare 4 Today[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d8552fbf1ab798421881202c8cc076c85f00aad5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Stay tuned to the latest official [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] information by checking the [url="https://www.callofduty.com/blog"]Call of Duty Blog[/url] through launch and beyond.[/p][p][/p][p]Pre-orders are [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4435490/Call_of_Duty_Modern_Warfare_4/"]available now on Steam[/url].[/p]

newsitems.title: Bungie раскроет планы по возвращению контента в Destiny 2 на следующей неделе
newsitems.contents:
Bungie продолжает работать над возвращением контента, удалённого из Destiny 2 за прошедшие годы. Ранее компания заявила, что «не собирается останавливаться» и намерена сохранить наследие франшизы, начав с восстановления всего, что было убрано из игры.

Как сообщает TheGamePost, Джош Дин ответил игрокам в X, отметив, что команда «планирует выпустить обновление» о процессе разблокировки контента на следующей неделе. В предыдущем посте он признал, что у сообщества могут возникнуть вопросы о разблокировке, потенциальных будущих обновлениях Destiny 2 и о том, что ждёт франшизу в целом.

По словам Дина, процесс будет «очень продуманным», а о первом этапе расскажут ближе к концу октября. Он также уточнил, что предстоящее обновление не будет традиционной дорожной картой — вместо этого информацию представят в виде «индикатора прогресса». Цель — приблизить сообщество к этапам разработки, чётко обозначить возникающие проблемы и предоставить игрокам наглядные доказательства проделанной работы.

Точную дату публикации сообщения Джош Дин не назвал.
